result.topic_en: Calculations on the hypergeometric (Riemann P-function) differential equation: the Wronskian of two solutions, and the transformation of the quantity (dz/dx)^{-1/2} under a change of variable from x to ξ, as used for the Schwarzian derivative and conformal mapping of the quotient of solutions.
result.transcription:
$\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right)^{\frac12}\frac{\partial^2\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right)^{-\frac12}}{\partial x^2}$

$(1-x)\frac{\partial^2 y}{\partial \log x^2} - (\alpha+\alpha'+(\beta+\beta')x)\frac{\partial y}{\partial \log x} + (\alpha\alpha' - \beta\beta' x)\, y = 0$

[-$\frac{\partial y_2}{\partial x}\,y_1$-]
$y_1\frac{\partial y_2}{\partial x} - y_2\frac{\partial y_1}{\partial x} = x^{\alpha+\alpha'-1}(1-x)^{\gamma+\gamma'-1}$

$\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right)^{-\frac12} = y\, x^{-\frac{\alpha+\alpha'-1}{2}}(1-x)^{-\frac{\gamma+\gamma'-1}{2}}$

$\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial \xi}\right)^{\frac12}\frac{\partial^2\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial \xi}\right)^{-\frac12}}{\partial \xi^2} =$

$\frac{\partial\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right)^{-\frac12}\left(\frac{\partial x}{\partial \xi}\right)^{-\frac12}}{\partial \xi} = \frac{\partial\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right)^{-\frac12}}{\partial x}\left(\frac{\partial x}{\partial \xi}\right)^{\frac12} + \left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right)^{-\frac12}\frac{\partial\left(\frac{\partial x}{\partial \xi}\right)^{-\frac12}}{\partial \xi}$

$\frac{\partial^2\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial \xi}\right)^{-\frac12}}{\partial \xi^2} = \frac{\partial^2\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right)^{-\frac12}}{\partial x^2}\left(\frac{\partial x}{\partial \xi}\right)^{\frac32} + \frac{\partial\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right)^{-\frac12}}{\partial x}\frac{\partial\left(\frac{\partial x}{\partial \xi}\right)^{\frac12}}{\partial \xi}$
$+\frac{\partial\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right)^{-\frac12}}{\partial x}\frac{\partial x}{\partial \xi}\frac{\partial\left(\frac{\partial x}{\partial \xi}\right)^{-\frac12}}{\partial \xi} + \left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right)^{-\frac12}\frac{\partial^2\left(\frac{\partial x}{\partial \xi}\right)^{-\frac12}}{\partial \xi^2}$

$\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial \xi}\right)^{\frac12}\frac{\partial^2\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial \xi}\right)^{-\frac12}}{\partial \xi^2} = \left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right)^{\frac12}\frac{\partial^2\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right)^{-\frac12}}{\partial x^2}\left(\frac{\partial x}{\partial \xi}\right)^2 + \left(\frac{\partial x}{\partial \xi}\right)^{\frac12}\frac{\partial^2\left(\frac{\partial x}{\partial \xi}\right)^{-\frac12}}{\partial \xi^2}$

methods.what: Wronskian of two solutions of the hypergeometric equation expressed via the exponents
Expression of (dz/dx)^{-1/2} (z = quotient of solutions) as a normalized solution y
Chain-rule transformation law of the expression (z')^{1/2}(z'^{-1/2})'' (essentially the Schwarzian derivative) under change of variable x -> xi
